Title: Solution Layout and Project Naming
Content: Solution file: Orchestrator.slnx. Plan names use SplitBrain.* conceptually; actual projects use Orchestrator.* and NodeClient.* prefixes. Core projects: Orchestrator.Core (models, interfaces, configs, FluentValidation), Orchestrator.Infrastructure (registry, routing, health, metrics, logging, queue, LiteDB agent log), Orchestrator.Agents (bounded deterministic agent engine), Orchestrator.Mcp (MCP server + tools), Orchestrator.NodeWorker (HTTP inference worker for Machine B, port 5050), SplitBrain.Dashboard (Blazor dark-theme UI), Orchestrator.Hosting (host bootstrap). NodeClient projects: NodeClient.Ollama, NodeClient.Copilot, NodeClient.Worker, NodeClient.LlamaCpp. Tests: Orchestrator.Tests (NUnit 4.5.1, 221+ tests). Storage: file-backed nodes.json + routing.json + LiteDB; SQLite migration planned (D3).
